name: fontes
description: Court decisions and legislation from government and court websites in 125 jurisdictions, fetched live, with a link to the original. Past versions of laws and 91 more countries come from Lexifina's record (not the official publisher).

fr_piste_client_id.title: France: PISTE client ID
fr_piste_client_id.description: Optional. From a free PISTE account; turns France on. Guide: https://github.com/ykarapazar/fontes/blob/main/docs/KEYS.md

fr_piste_client_secret.title: France: PISTE client secret
fr_piste_client_secret.description: Optional. The secret that goes with the PISTE client ID.

us_govinfo_key.title: United States: api.data.gov key
us_govinfo_key.description: Optional. A free api.data.gov key; without it US case-law search allows about 10 searches a day.

us_courtlistener_key.title: US state courts: CourtListener token
us_courtlistener_key.description: Optional. Your own free CourtListener API token; turns on US state case law (unofficial source, run by the non-profit Free Law Project).
